Message:
How’s it hanging, my Duke?
Need something from me?

Oooh, what’s this?
Can I take that as you taking
more of an interest in lil’ old me?

Hehe. Well, I’m afraid
these lips are sealed!
Even for you, my Duke!

Us girls are made of sugar,
spice, and slices of vice,
don’cha know?

“That’s not how the rhyme goes?”
Really? Hey, come on now!
Don’t sweat the small stuff!

Besides, secrets have value
because they’re secret.
If you spill everything,
it just ruins the fun!

Even so, you wanna know, huh?
You’re really something else,
my Duke.
Just what am I gonna
do about you?

...I guess I could tell you
one little fairy tale.
How’s that sound?

Here’s the story of a few animals
who tried to save the world...
